purpose: Migrations that exist in a deployed database on purpose and have no file in supabase/migrations, so the schema-drift gate can tell a deliberate operator installation from an unexplained one. Every entry names why it cannot be an ordinary migration. Anything not listed here is reported.

migrations.name: install_own_report_retention_scheduler
migrations.why: An operator-only pg_cron installation. Its own preflight refuses unless current_user is postgres, the database is postgres and pg_cron is in shared_preload_libraries — conditions the ordinary migration flow cannot promise — and it deliberately creates an INACTIVE job that a separate operator step activates. Observed applied to production 2026-09-08; no file with this name has ever existed under supabase/migrations in this repository's history.
